page.overview:
Who is Alien Psychic?

Alien Psychic, known as Alien Psycho in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Alien Psychic".

Alien Psychic appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. It appears as a Tag Duel opponent and it Tag partner is Alien Mars.

They can be unlocked if the player has beaten the team known as, First Contact five times. Their team name is Counter Culture.
